name: Ragefire Chasm
blockers_notes: None; simple circular cavern loops with zero doors or gates.
reason: Compact, linear loop with zero doors, keys, or mechanics; ideal entry-level rift.

name: The Deadmines
blockers_notes: Ironclad Door requires firing the Defias Cannon with blasting powder after killing Rhahk'Zor/Sneed/Gilnid.
reason: Ironclad Door is a hard event blocker requiring cannon blasting powder mechanic.

name: Wailing Caverns
blockers_notes: Complex multi-wing winding maze with chasm jump puzzles; final boss (Mutanus) requires Disciple of Naralex ritual escort event.
reason: Confusing winding cave maze with jump hazards and a mandatory NPC ritual escort.

name: Shadowfang Keep
blockers_notes: Courtyard gate locked until cell prisoner event; tower doors locked until killing Baron Silverlaine and Commander Springvale.
reason: Multiple locked doors and prisoner jail-cell event gates block forward progress.

name: Blackfathom Deeps
blockers_notes: Altar of the Deeps candle lighting event required to open door to Aku'mai; jumping platforms over water and swimming tunnels.
reason: Underwater swimming tunnels, platform jumping hazards, and mandatory four-candle lighting event.

name: The Stockade
blockers_notes: None; open central hallway with side prison wings and zero locked doors.
reason: Compact layout with high mob density and zero locked doors or event gates.

name: Gnomeregan
blockers_notes: Workshop back door requires Workshop Key; massive multi-tier maze, elevator shafts, and radioactive contamination areas.
reason: Multi-tier branching maze with lethal falling hazards, elevator shafts, and locked key doors.

name: Razorfen Kraul
blockers_notes: None; winding open thorn-corridor loop with zero locked doors.
reason: Natural winding path with consistent trash density and no locked doors or event gates.

name: Scarlet Monastery - Graveyard
blockers_notes: None; outdoor courtyard leading into underground crypts with zero locked doors.
reason: Completely unlocked, short linear wing with great atmosphere and clear flow.

name: Scarlet Monastery - Library
blockers_notes: None; entrance does not require a key; linear cloister path through garden and halls to Arcanist Doan.
reason: Linear cloister and library halls, unlocked entry, and smooth trash progression.

name: Scarlet Monastery - Armory
blockers_notes: Outer entrance door locked, requiring Scarlet Key (found in Library) or lockpicking.
reason: Entrance gate is locked, requiring Scarlet Key or lockpicking.

name: Scarlet Monastery - Cathedral
blockers_notes: Outer entrance door locked, requiring Scarlet Key or lockpicking; High Inquisitor door locks during boss encounter.
reason: Entrance gate requires Scarlet Key or lockpicking.

name: Razorfen Downs
blockers_notes: None; linear path through thorned bone tunnels ending at Amnennar with zero locked doors.
reason: Well-paced linear cave layout with zero locked doors, keys, or blocking events.

name: Uldaman
blockers_notes: Ironaya's vault requires Keystone pedestal activation; Archaedas chamber requires 3-player altar activation ritual.
reason: Sprawling branching layout with mandatory object pedestals and altar activation events.

name: Zul'Farrak
blockers_notes: Pyramid stairs gauntlet event with cages and NPC executioners; door to Chief Ukorz Sandscalp remains closed until pyramid event completes.
reason: Massive open sand city with an extended scripted pyramid defense event blocking the final boss.

name: Maraudon - Purple: The Wicked Grotto
blockers_notes: Winding cavern maze with crystals, cliffs, and multiple dead ends.
reason: Confusing cavern maze with multi-level drops and excessive backtracking.

name: Maraudon - Orange: Foulspore Cavern
blockers_notes: Complex subterranean cavern network with poison pools and steep slopes.
reason: Vast, winding layout with hazardous terrain and poor forward momentum.

name: Sunken Temple
blockers_notes: Statue lighting sequence in lower ring; Eranikus sealed behind forcefield until 6 upstairs balcony minibosses are slain.
reason: Multi-tier circular maze with complex statue puzzle and forcefield-sealed sanctum.

name: Blackrock Depths
blockers_notes: Shadowforge Lock mechanism requires Shadowforge Key; East/West gates; Grim Guzzler door puzzle; Lyceum dual brazier torch run.
reason: Massive multi-hour labyrinth with numerous locked key doors, gear locks, and torch events.

name: Lower Blackrock Spire
blockers_notes: Multi-level vertical fortress with jump-down shortcuts, narrow ledges, and numerous branching corridors.
reason: Highly vertical multi-level maze with disorienting paths and falling hazards.

name: Upper Blackrock Spire
blockers_notes: Hall of Blackhand door requires Seal of Ascension key; Rookery egg events and wave defense in the Stadium.
reason: Entrance requires Seal of Ascension ring key; stadium arena wave event interrupts run.

name: Dire Maul - East
blockers_notes: None; entrance is completely unlocked; linear path through conservatory and subterranean roots down to Alzzin.
reason: Unlocked entrance, spacious ruins, high trash pack density, and clear path down to Alzzin.

name: Dire Maul - West
blockers_notes: Requires Crescent Key to enter; 5 Mana Pylons must be deactivated by killing elementals to drop forcefield around Immol'thar.
reason: Requires Crescent Key and destroying 5 separate pylon packs to drop central barrier.

name: Dire Maul - North
blockers_notes: Requires Crescent Key to enter; Gordok Courtyard Key and Inner Door Key required to progress through fortress doors.
reason: Requires Crescent Key plus multiple interior door keys found on guards.

name: Scholomance
blockers_notes: Skeleton Key required to enter; Viewing Room Door requires key; 6 side study rooms must be fully cleared to open Gandling's chamber.
reason: Front door locked with Skeleton Key; requires full clear of six separate study chambers to unlock final boss.

name: Stratholme - Main Gate
blockers_notes: Interior street gates locked with Scarlet Key and Key to the City; gate portcullis traps with maggots.
reason: City streets obstructed by locked iron gates and portcullis trap ambushes.

name: Stratholme - Service Gate
blockers_notes: Service entrance locked with Key to the City; three Ziggurats must be cleared of acolyte cultists to unlock Slaughterhouse gates.
reason: Locked entrance gate and mandatory three-ziggurat cultist clearing to open slaughterhouse.

name: Hellfire Ramparts
blockers_notes: None; completely open linear fortress battlements with zero locked doors.
reason: Exemplary rift layout: 100% linear, great mob density, and zero doors, keys, or events.

name: The Blood Furnace
blockers_notes: Broggok chamber has 4 prison cell levers that must be pulled to release orc waves before the boss.
reason: Tight linear corridors with consistent flow; Broggok levers are quick trash activations.

name: The Shattered Halls
blockers_notes: Entrance sewer grate requires Shattered Halls Key outside; inside sewer gauntlet has archer slime corridors.
reason: Linear dungeon with high enemy density; entrance key check is bypassed via direct rift teleport.

name: The Slave Pens
blockers_notes: None; open loop through cavern pens and walkways with zero locked doors.
reason: Linear cavern loop with zero locked doors, straightforward navigation, and natural pathing.

name: The Underbog
blockers_notes: None; single winding path ascending through fungal ledges to the Black Stalker.
reason: Continuous linear progression along cavern terraces with zero doors or blocking events.

name: The Steamvault
blockers_notes: Main Access Control levers behind Hydromancer Thespia and Mekgineer Steamrigger must both be flipped to open the gate to Warlord Kalithresh.
reason: Two straightforward wings flanking the central reservoir; clean progression with high mob count.

name: Mana-Tombs
blockers_notes: None; linear loop through ethereal burial chambers with zero locked doors.
reason: Compact, beautifully linear crypt layout with zero locked doors or gating events.

name: Auchenai Crypts
blockers_notes: None; descending hallway through two large hall chambers with zero locked doors.
reason: Very short, direct linear corridor with zero doors, keys, or mechanics.

name: Sethekk Halls
blockers_notes: None; completely linear single hallway winding up to Talon King Ikiss with zero locked doors.
reason: One of the most linear dungeons in WoW; uninterrupted forward movement and zero doors.

name: Shadow Labyrinth
blockers_notes: Exterior door requires Shadow Labyrinth Key outside; doors inside unlock sequentially as Hellmaw and Blackheart fall.
reason: Linear grand cloister with huge trash packs and straightforward boss gates; entrance key bypassed by rift teleport.

name: Old Hillsbrad Foothills
blockers_notes: Requires planting incendiary bombs in 5 internment lodges, followed by a long scripted Thrall escort on horseback to Tarren Mill.
reason: Mandatory 5-barrel arson objective and slow scripted NPC horseback escort.

name: The Black Morass
blockers_notes: Stationary swamp arena with 18 sequential portal waves spawning on fixed timers around Medivh; no forward run-through.
reason: Wave defense around a static NPC on fixed timers; no forward dungeon run-through.

name: The Mechanar
blockers_notes: Elevator between lower and upper floor operates automatically; zero locked doors.
reason: Short two-tier linear facility with dense elite packs and smooth flow.

name: The Botanica
blockers_notes: None; single massive linear horseshoe loop through biolabs with zero locked doors.
reason: Wide linear loop with enormous trash volume, zero locked doors, and steady progression.

name: The Arcatraz
blockers_notes: Protean door locked until first two bosses die; final boss (Harbinger Skyriss) locked behind Warden Mellichar pod opening sequence.
reason: Locked security doors and mandatory scripted stasis pod sequence before the final boss.

name: Magisters' Terrace
blockers_notes: Scrying orb security barrier opens automatically upon defeating Delrissa; otherwise linear palace halls.
reason: Highly polished linear palace route with varied packs and automatic boss progression doors.

name: Utgarde Keep
blockers_notes: None; linear progression through vrykul fortress halls and proto-drake pens with zero locked doors.
reason: Fast, strictly linear path with great monster density and zero gating mechanics.

name: Utgarde Pinnacle
blockers_notes: Skadi gauntlet involves harpoon guns to ground boss; path through halls is otherwise completely linear and unlocked.
reason: Linear castle rampart run with great enemy variety; harpoon mechanic can be bypassed if scaled boss is pulled.

name: The Nexus
blockers_notes: Three elemental wings surrounding central frozen prison; defeating 3 bosses drops the ice barrier around Keristrasza.
reason: Spacious three-wing hub with wide circular corridors and high trash density.

name: The Oculus
blockers_notes: Mandatory drake flight vehicles with vehicle action bars required to move between platforms and fight Eregos.
reason: Mandatory drake vehicle mounts and vehicle combat violate core Diablocraft boots-on-the-ground design.

name: Azjol-Nerub
blockers_notes: Spider webs block forward descent until Krik'thir and Hadronox are defeated; water pool drop to final chamber.
reason: Extremely fast, linear downward descent with zero keys or vehicle mechanics.

name: Ahn'kahet: The Old Kingdom
blockers_notes: Jedoga gate requires killing two Twilight initiate packs; otherwise a wide grand descent down to Herald Volazj.
reason: Epic underground nerubian city with wide boulevards, dense packs, and linear progression.

name: Drak'Tharon Keep
blockers_notes: None; continuous linear ramp ascent from lower courtyard to the fortress roof with zero locked doors.
reason: Completely linear outdoor fortress ramp with zero locked doors or gating events.

name: Halls of Stone
blockers_notes: Tribunal of Ages is a mandatory 5-minute timed wave defense event escorting Brann Bronzebeard before Sjonnir's door opens.
reason: Tribunal of Ages is a forced 5-minute timed survival event with non-skippable NPC roleplay.

name: Halls of Lightning
blockers_notes: None; grand linear titanium corridors winding from Bjarngrim to Loken with zero locked doors.
reason: Imposing linear titan halls with high pack density, zero locked doors, and epic pacing.

name: Gundrak
blockers_notes: Central bridge to Gal'darah requires interacting with 3 altar pedestals behind Slad'ran, Moorabi, and Colossus.
reason: Circular perimeter canal with clear boss wings; altar bridge puzzle easily handled after clearing.

name: Violet Hold
blockers_notes: Stationary prison room with 18 timed portal waves spawning on fixed clock intervals; no forward run-through.
reason: Single-room timed wave defense with zero dungeon traversal.

name: The Culling of Stratholme
blockers_notes: Crate revealing phase; 10-wave city defense; lengthy unskippable Arthas roleplay dialogue; Arthas escort through town.
reason: Extensive unskippable Arthas dialogue, crate sniffing, and slow scripted town escort.

name: Trial of the Champion
blockers_notes: Mandatory jousting vehicle combat phase on tournament mounts; static arena with wave announcements.
reason: Mandatory jousting vehicle combat in a circular arena; no dungeon layout to run.

name: The Forge of Souls
blockers_notes: None; single S-shaped catwalk descending across skull foundry to Devourer of Souls with zero locked doors.
reason: Perfect Diablo aesthetic, short linear catwalk, dense trash packs, and zero doors or events.

name: Pit of Saron
blockers_notes: Circular quarry path leading through a falling icicle cave gauntlet up to Tyrannus; zero locked doors.
reason: Scenic open quarry ring with great mob clusters and continuous forward progress.

name: Halls of Reflection
blockers_notes: Mandatory 10-wave survival event in first chamber; gauntlet fleeing The Lich King behind ice walls with Jaina/Sylvanas.
reason: Wave defense followed by heavily scripted ice-wall chase with strict NPC escort mechanics.
